name: surveillance
description: SPECTER — player spy networks + a witnessed-crime wanted system. P1-5: plant/hub/record/counterplay/devices. P6: 0-5 star wanted, escalating police tiers up to Arbiters, evidence + bounties. Also consumes storefront.staffWitnessed — hired shop staff (plugins/storefront) are a forced witness for shoplifting/hacking, the same convention as vendor.safeHackWitnessed.

scrub.note: Declaration-only specializedAction (requiredFlag) — the terminal advertises scrub on examine; cmdScrub still owns the verb.

bribe.note: KNOWN GAP: on-scene cop NPC advertises this only via dialogue, not examine

submit.note: KNOWN GAP: on-scene cop NPC advertises this only via dialogue, not examine

retrieve.note: KNOWN GAP: acts on a concealed planted-device furniture revealed only by sweep; sweep output hints retrieve but examine lists no action (the device carries no tag/interactions).

smash.note: KNOWN GAP: destroys a swept-out device furniture; not hinted by sweep, not surfaced by examine.

hijack.note: KNOWN GAP: breaches a swept-out device furniture; no examine/sweep hint.

devices.note: Lists your own deployed units. Exists because destruct/cast have no discoverable targets otherwise — a device id is a uuid and the SPECTER app was the only thing that ever showed you the list.

destruct.note: Remote-scuttles one of your own units. TWO-STEP (… confirm): destroyed, never recovered, and unlike the app there is no focused tile to disambiguate, so the confirmation doubles as the disambiguation. Was a SPECTER-app button only.

cast.note: Patches one of your cameras onto a consumer deck in this room (toggles). Delegates the whole rule to broadcast patchCamToDeck. Was a SPECTER-app button only. NOTE: the bare word is currently free, but it is the natural verb for fishing too — if fishing ever wants it, rename this one.

crush.note: Destroys a saved microreel. The reel IS the datachip you carry, so this destroys a tradeable object — two-step, and named for what happens to the chip. Was a SPECTER-app button only.
